params.name: duration
params.desc: Output video duration in seconds. Default: 5. When there is no video input, the value must be within [2, 30]. When reference videos are provided: input video du

params.name: audio
params.desc: Whether the output video includes an audio track. Default: true.

params.name: seed
params.desc: Random seed used to reproduce results. If omitted, a random seed is used.

params.name: nsfw_checker
params.desc: Defaults to false. You can set it to false based on your needs. If set to false, our content filtering will be disabled, and all results will be returned direct
